set.body: Compile explicit requirements for total, coherent, configuration, and full geometry. Total-only execution must form projected atoms and contract them without local relations, coherent geometry, or marginals. Coherent direct execution needs local relations and coherent output only; configuration needs total plus coherent; full geometry retains both components and marginals. Memory plans and receipts must reflect only requested work. Prove every direct component equals the corresponding late query.
set.title: Make direct execution component-aware
